title: bromus villosulus
intro: Bromus villosulus, commonly known as woolly brome, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Bromus villosulus include its ability to provide relief from digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bromus villosulus include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
